description: Astronomy Picture of the Day, near-Earth asteroid data from NeoWs, space weather from DONKI, DSCOVR EPIC imagery, EONET natural events and the NASA Image and Video Library.

api.description: List Astronomy Picture of the Day entries, newest first, or a date range in the legacy YYMMDD form; NASA serves at most 25 per page
